## [Luminar Neo drops the Neo, with a new interface and autumn release](https://camerajabber.com/photography-news/luminar-neo-drops-the-neo-with-a-new-interface-and-autumn-release/)
*Camera Jabber* | 11/08/2026 | Score: 0.87
Tags: photography, photo_editing, photography_ai

> Skylum is dropping the “Neo”. The company has confirmed that Luminar Neo is being renamed simply Luminar, alongside a substantial interface overhaul that is available to all users today and a larger release due this autumn, now open for pre-order. Details are on the Skylum website. The name change is more sensible than it might appear. Luminar Neo arrived in 2022 as the successor to Luminar AI, which itself replaced Luminar 4, and the resulting naming has done the software no favours — particularly for anyone searching for tutorials or trying to work out which version they actually own. Reverting to plain Luminar removes a layer of confusion. The interface upgrade is the part existing users will notice immediately. Luminar’s editing tools have generally been well regarded, particularly its AI-driven sky replacement, relighting and generative features, but the interface has drawn criticism for being slower and less predictable than rivals....
